name: @odu/cordis
//: THE SERVICE-TAG CONTRACT — what a row may `needs` and what the host `provide`s, in one module that belongs to NEITHER. `@odu/host` is the registry (it names every row) and a row may not import the registry; a row's own package cannot hold the tags the other rows need. So the vocabulary lives here, and both sides name it.
//dependencies: One install: the plugin runtime. Everything else is a TYPE from the surface framework. No `@odu/*` at all — this module is what makes host and rows able to share a vocabulary without naming each other, so naming one would undo it in a line. `src/closure.test.ts` holds that.
